image_url.description: URL of the input image to convert to a 3D model.

shape_slat_sampling_steps.description: Number of denoising steps for the shape stage.

geometry_lora_url.description: Optional safetensors LoRA checkpoint trained for the geometry denoiser.

tex_slat_rescale_t.description: Noise-schedule sharpness for the texture stage.

shape_slat_rescale_t.description: Noise-schedule sharpness for the shape stage.

tex_slat_sampling_steps.description: Number of denoising steps for the texture stage.

decimation_target.description: Target vertex count for the exported GLB.

sparse_structure_lora_url.description: Optional safetensors LoRA checkpoint trained for the sparse structure denoiser.

ss_guidance_rescale.description: Guidance rescale for the sparse-structure stage; higher stabilizes output.

ss_rescale_t.description: Noise-schedule sharpness for the sparse-structure stage.

shape_slat_guidance_interval_start.description: Denoising fraction at which guidance starts for the shape stage.

ss_guidance_interval_end.description: Denoising fraction at which guidance ends for the sparse-structure stage. Must be >= ss_guidance_interval_start.

texture_lora_url.description: Optional safetensors LoRA checkpoint trained for the texture denoiser.

ss_guidance_interval_start.description: Denoising fraction at which guidance starts for the sparse-structure stage.

tex_slat_guidance_rescale.description: Guidance rescale for the texture stage; increase if textures look noisy.

shape_slat_guidance_interval_end.description: Denoising fraction at which guidance ends for the shape stage. Must be >= shape_slat_guidance_interval_start.

tex_slat_guidance_strength.description: Classifier-free guidance strength for the texture stage.

shape_slat_guidance_rescale.description: Guidance rescale for the shape stage; increase if geometry looks noisy.

texture_size.description: Texture resolution baked into the exported GLB.

ss_sampling_steps.description: Number of denoising steps for the sparse-structure stage.

shape_slat_guidance_strength.description: Classifier-free guidance strength for the shape stage.

resolution.description: Generation resolution. Must match the resolution the provided LoRA adapters were trained at (1024 runs the cascade pipeline).

ss_guidance_strength.description: Classifier-free guidance strength for the sparse-structure stage.

tex_slat_guidance_interval_start.description: Denoising fraction at which guidance starts for the texture stage.

tex_slat_guidance_interval_end.description: Denoising fraction at which guidance ends for the texture stage. Must be >= tex_slat_guidance_interval_start.
